claims.quote: The Canara pearlspot cichlid, Etroplus canarensis, appears to be endemic to the Kumaradhara-Netravati river system in southern Karnataka, India.
Appears locally endemic to southern Karnataka state, southwestern India where it's known only from the Kumaradhara-Netravati river system.
